stanley_steer — DRIVE lateral op

• Data kinds: any → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.stanley_steer(front_pose, path, *, gain: 'float', speed, softening: 'float' = 0.0, max_steer: 'float' = inf, start_index=None, window: 'int' = 40) -> 'Dict[str, np.ndarray]' (to call the implementation directly, import drivelateral; drivelateral.stanley_steer(front_pose, path, *, gain: 'float', speed, softening: 'float' = 0.0, max_steer: 'float' = inf, start_index=None, window: 'int' = 40) -> 'Dict[str, np.ndarray]'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("stanley_steer"))

Usage

Stanley steering angle δ = ψ_e + atan2(−k e, k_s + v) (the lateral offset e of the front-axle center is positive to the left of the path; ψ_e = path heading − ψ).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

front_pose: (3,) または (N, 3)。max_steer で切る(切ると stanley_straight_decay の閉形式から外れる)。

返り値: steer, lateral, heading_error, index。

Raises ValueError: 形の誤り、k ≤ 0、v < 0、k_s < 0、max_steer ≤ 0。
